decision.title: Customer personal data
decision.question: Lumen_Books_Customer carries name, email and phone. How should the subgraph treat them?
decision.context: Recommendation: hide-contact. Email and phone are personal data the spec flags; masking needs string handling in the mapping and is harder to test. Email is required in the source, so hiding it is a recorded omit.

choices.label: Expose name, hide email and phone
Hide name, email and phone (id, tier, createdAt only)
Expose masked email and phone (e.g. j***@x.com, last digits of phone)
